product: commentary — no product. The AI-influencer-as-a-service business model (retainers $1.5k–$10k/mo).
hook: "the only legit way to make money with an AI UGC influencer... is to sell ads to brands."
body: Six steps: create a half-second-recognizable character in Higgsfield; pick one niche; study the niche's most viral UGC formats; remake them with your character via Genjutsu; build 3–5 example ads; pitch DTC brands $1,500–$10,000/mo retainers. The pitch: brands burn through ads; your character never tires, never reshoots, delivers tonight. "The character builds the attention. The retainer is the business." 10s video attached (transcript is a fragment).
idea: The AI character is a creative service with a retainer — attention is the product, ads are the deliverable.
why_it_works: Retainers sell reliability — "fresh creatives tonight" beats "viral someday."
what_to_steal: Flip it for LC: instead of buying character retainers, BUILD LC's own recurring AI character — the retainer math proves characters are worth owning.
